description: Computing node J, cold plate C and common radiator R with the JC and CR connections against the whole-satellite COMSOL model of 30 August 2026 (OrbitWiz vs COMSOL 6.3 full twin). Parameters are derived from the FE model definition files by T5; the FE temperatures are used only as the comparison reference.

fe.source: Whole-satellite FE model: COMSOL 6.3 solid heat transfer with surface-to-surface radiation and orbital thermal loads, strict BDF-1 steps of 120 s over 5 orbits (3 orbits plus a verified 2-orbit continuation), REPORT.md sections 5 to 7.8

report_o45_source: REPORT.md section 7.8 table, orbits 4 to 5 cyclic means (sample mean of the 120 s probe output over 3P <= tau <= 5P, as computed by compare_report.py)

environment.solar_irradiance_rule: mean of the trace column solar_flux_w_m2 over T0_HOT_S - 120 s <= t_s <= T0_HOT_S + 3 P + 60 s, rounded to 0.01 W/m2, exactly as build_comsol.write_inputs set the COMSOL parameter S_sun (the 2-orbit continuation reused the model and its S_sun)
environment.source: PHASE1_ADDENDUM_materials.md rows Albedo / Earth IR (geodyn.py:34, 33: 0.30 and 237 W/m2), Earth radius for view factors (COMSOL Earth preset 6378 km), solar irradiance in COMSOL (1361/d_AU^2 on the date); build_comsol.py lines 166, 213-221; deep-space 2.7 K of the FE is not represented (thermal design 4.4 has no background term; its emission at 2.7 K is below 1e-6 W)

attitude_source: build_comsol.py lines 222-223 (spacecraft axes primary z to nadir, secondary y to velocity) and run_orbitwiz.py sample(): body +X = r x v (orbit normal, solar cell normal), +Y = z x x (ram, radiator faces), +Z = -r (nadir)
orbit_source: build_comsol.py write_inputs: COMSOL orbit = the OrbitWiz SGP4 positions of the 1 s trace (TEME), Sun = the OrbitWiz analytic Sun direction of the trace (TEME); tau = t_s - T0_HOT_S
power_source: build_comsol.py lines 175-181 and write_inputs: per-package heat rate Pgpu = trace heat_per_gpu_w (0.95 times the per-card draw), platform heat Pplat = trace heat_platform_w (0.95 x 600 W) spread over the bus, both linearly interpolated in tau from the 1 s table

SolarArray01.source: geometry_spec.py wings() (7 clusters per wing, 2 wings, cluster 2.560 m x 1.469 m), SOL_AREAL_KG_M2 2.5 kg/m2 with aluminium cp 900 J/kgK, OPT_CELL_FRONT alpha 0.80 - 0.20 = 0.60 eps 0.85 and OPT_CELL_BACK alpha 0.80 eps 0.85; the FE folds the electrical output into the cell absorptivity, so P_pv_W = 0 keeps the same energy balance

Compute01.source: geometry_spec.py blades() (12 blade boxes extended to the spine face, 12 package boxes), BUS (spine, two thrusters, two tanks), aluminium rho 2700 kg/m3 and cp 900 J/kgK of the COMSOL library (PHASE1_ADDENDUM_materials.md row 1); union volumes of the FE blocks

ColdPlate01.source: geometry_spec.py heat_pipe_blocks(400 x 0.95) as called by build_comsol.py line 111: four transport bundles of 5 pipes and four connectors, solid aluminium capacity (build_comsol.py line 198)

Radiator01.source: geometry_spec.py radiators() (2 panels 1.98 m x 0.792 m, faces +Y and -Y), RAD_AREAL_KG_M2 4.4 kg/m2, OPT_WHITEPAINT alpha 0.25 eps 0.85 (state_engine.py:180 WhitePaint, user decision A), headers and spreaders of heat_pipe_blocks with solid aluminium capacity; radiating area of the FE = both faces of both panels 6.273 m2 (REPORT.md section 6 check 3)

auxiliary_nodes.note: The FE model has no battery and no separate power equipment (REPORT.md section 5 simplifications: battery not modelled; platform heat uniform over the bus). B and D are auxiliary nodes with explicit test values, carry zero heat and are decoupled from R by a very large resistance; they are not compared.
auxiliary_nodes.source: FE-004 auxiliary node, not compared; explicit test value

decoupling.SR_source: FE-004 test configuration recorded per thermal design 9.4: the FE solar wings are separate, non-touching domains without booms (PHASE1_ADDENDUM_materials.md geometry simplification 4), so SR takes a very large resistance that represents no conduction
decoupling.BR_source: FE-004 test configuration recorded per thermal design 9.4: the FE model has no battery, so BR takes a very large resistance and Q_B_W is zero
decoupling.DR_source: FE-004 test configuration recorded per thermal design 9.4: the FE model has no separate power equipment, so DR takes a very large resistance and Q_D_W is zero in the main configuration

temperature_range_source: declared applicability range of the constant FE material and optical values; the FE uses constant properties and its temperatures lie in 255 K to 380 K

solver.source: thermal design table 8: adaptive RK45, relative tolerance, temperature absolute tolerance in K and maximum step in s as scene settings, output on the accepted solution every 60 s; the maximum step stays below the RK45 stability limit of the cold plate node (time constant about 18 s); power steps above 2 W per GPU are declared as input discontinuities

criteria.fe_eclipse_resolution_source: REPORT.md section 5 simplifications: 120 s strict steps, eclipse edges resolved to +/-120 s
criteria.single_node_source: FE-004 expected result: the single-node model is 12 to 15 degC below the GPU baseplate in the same comparison (REPORT.md section 7.8: +12.5 and +15.1 degC); the statement is checked at its integer precision

reference_quadrature.method: Earth-centred Gauss-Legendre quadrature in the central angle and midpoint rule in azimuth over the visible spherical cap of a Lambertian Earth; independent of sdtwin_sim.earth_flux, which integrates over the satellite sky
